node_updates.purpose: CLI entrypoint for the synthetic request-processing service. The main guard delegates to service.run.
node_updates.inputs: Process startup; no command-line arguments are read.
node_updates.outputs: Invokes the request-processing loop; no return value is consumed.

node_updates.purpose: Consumes pending requests, selects enabled entries, evaluates their expressions and delegates persistence. Broad exceptions are discarded.
node_updates.inputs: Iterable of request dictionaries from storage.pending; enabled and expression fields.
node_updates.outputs: Calls storage.save for successful results. Failed requests are silently skipped; no result is returned.

node_updates.purpose: Storage adapter. pending currently returns an empty list; save converts a result to text and replaces result.txt. Imports service even though it is not referenced elsewhere in this file.
node_updates.outputs: UTF-8 text in result.txt, relative to the process working directory. pending returns an empty list.

findings.title: Every successful result replaces the same output file
findings.observation: storage.save calls Path('result.txt').write_text for every result. service.run calls save inside its processing loop.
findings.impact: If pending is changed to yield several enabled requests, later results replace earlier results. The current pending implementation returns an empty list, so that path produces no writes as shipped.
findings.proposal: Confirm whether the intended contract is latest-result storage or retained per-request history before changing persistence.
